verdict: Boston Scientific sales barely grew — up just 1.5% to $5.1B — as an August cybersecurity incident disrupted operations, and one-off charges cut GAAP profit to $582M from $755M a year ago.

segments.name: MedSurg
segments.note: Endoscopy ($741M, -0.8%), Urology ($661M, -3.2%) and Neuromodulation ($331M, +13.1%) — devices for digestive, urinary and nerve conditions.

segments.name: Cardiovascular
segments.note: Heart and blood-vessel devices — the larger half of the company, up 1.9%. Shown $1M below the reported $3,406M so the segments add exactly to total sales (see footer).

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling the products and running the company day to day — down from $1,741M a year ago.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new medical devices — about flat vs $514M a year ago.

opex.name: Amortization
opex.note: Non-cash cost of past acquisitions, spread over time.

opex.name: Other operating charges, net
opex.note: Royalty expense $12M, an intangible-asset impairment of $39M, restructuring charges of $63M and litigation charges of $81M, less a $32M contingent-consideration benefit.

takeaways.title: Growth stalled after a cyber incident
takeaways.text: Sales grew just 1.5% — US sales rose only 0.5% — in a quarter disrupted by the August 2026 cybersecurity incident the company says its teams worked to recover from.

takeaways.title: One-off charges cut GAAP profit
takeaways.text: GAAP profit attributable to shareholders fell 23% to $582M ($0.40 per share) as litigation ($81M), restructuring ($63M) and impairment ($39M) charges landed. Adjusted EPS, which strips those out, was $0.73 vs $0.75 a year ago.

takeaways.title: Management expects a Q4 sales dip
takeaways.text: The company guided Q4 sales down 3% to 1% vs a year ago, with full-year adjusted EPS of $3.16 to $3.18 — a soft finish after the disrupted quarter.

oneTimers: Litigation-related charges of $81M, restructuring charges of $63M and a $39M intangible-asset impairment in the quarter — the main reasons GAAP EPS ($0.40) sits well below adjusted EPS ($0.73).
An August 2026 cybersecurity incident disrupted operations in the quarter; the company does not break out a separate dollar cost for it in the release.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $100M, partly offset by $4M of other income — reported as a net $95M cost (the components differ by $1M due to rounding in the release).
footerNote: The flow uses total net income of $580M; after a $2M loss attributable to noncontrolling interests, net income attributable to Boston Scientific shareholders was $582M ($0.40 per share). Cardiovascular sales are shown as $3,405M (reported $3,406M) so the two segments add exactly to the $5,138M total — a $1M rounding difference in the release.
